x: Belgrave's day did not get off to a very good start, for with four to score in the team event we were only able to field three runners - Eric Penny, Mike Smithers and Roy Bagley.
Eric Penny was fourth in the mile, whilst new members Mike Smithers and Roy Bagley both finished fifth in the first and second string 440 event with times of 58.5 and 59.5 respectively.
Although running well, Mike Smithers and Derek Wade failed to reach the final of the 100 yds. Brian Kolbe led all the way in the 880 yds. only to be passed in the home straight; his time was 2m.4s.

Our Juniors seem non-existent, although Mike Smithers and Alan Blackett have appeared in the Jumps- but where are the throwers? The same might be said for the Youths, except for Dereck Wade in the Jumps.

Our four runners were Roy Bagley, Mike Smithers, Eddie Gaze and Eric Penny in that order. George Edwards (Javelin, shot and high jump) and Mike Smithers (long jump and shot) were our stalwarts, as usual, in the field and gathered 26 points between them!

This let in Graham Worrall and Pat (Nanny-Goat) Cornelius and Mike Smithers to take the medals. The 'quarter' developed into a two horse race between Worrall and Pete Pepe, whose form over the hurdles has of late been so encouraging.
Smithers and Leroy had a private battle in the Long Jump with Mike just beating his less experienced rival by the odd half-inch (19'6½" to 19'6").

Worrall won the second string in 51.5 (probably 'niggled' at not being selected as No. 1.) Couzens won the Javelin (155'.1"), Kerr won the mile (4:18.1) and Mike Smithers popped up in several spots to collect valuable points.
